scope: Outcome-blind feasibility audit using only the frozen A1 joint-null calibration background and canonical native thresholds.

finding.reason: The transferred native gate alone occupies 1.5% of the independent L1 calibration background. A positive rescue gate cannot be added while simultaneously preserving that threshold and claiming a detector-wise 1% global false-positive rate.
finding.bootstrap_note: Counts are a feasibility diagnostic, not final thresholds. Any approved A2 must be recalibrated with raw-source-block bootstrap under its complete frozen decision rule.

scientific_options.separate_diagnostic_channels: Keep the canonical native decision unchanged and report multiscale rescue separately, without a unified 1% detection claim.
scientific_options.unified_one_percent_gate: Preserve a detector-wise 1% global target by allocating alpha and recalibrating both native and rescue components; the canonical native threshold cannot remain invariant.
scientific_options.preserve_native_and_raise_global_alpha: Keep the canonical native threshold and add rescue only after explicitly accepting and calibrating a global false-positive target above 1%.

decision_boundary: Selection of a unified alpha allocation or a higher global alpha changes what is measured and requires explicit scientific authorization before implementation.
